purpose: Determine whether simple source-trained mappings given the same observable information can explain the final predictor performance.

target.query: all retained records from index20 onward

final_ensemble: same fixed arithmetic mean of three outputs per readout
encoder: Reuse each frozen source-only global ACfC encoder;no source/target fine-tuning.

final_readout_configurations.head: shared ridge coefficients;5 known-domain intercept offsets
5 domain-specific ridge coefficient blocks;all other steps identical to M1

counts: 2 readout settings x3 frozen encoder components=6 final fitted model sets;M2 contains5 domain blocks. Source-only CV adds lightweight candidate fits.

source_data.trajectory_access: full source trajectories;all20 support and subsequent source labels allowed
source_data.interpretation: conservative source-label exposure upper-bound reference;not equal source record/optimization budget to every paper branch
source_data.reason: paper base encoder/reference use85%prefix while some residual/conditional heads use full source trajectories

head_normalization: fit on training source batteries only per fold;one shared feature schema for M1/M2;mean impute+missing flag+clip normalized numeric features to[-10,10]
learning_objective: source-domain-equal then source-battery-equal mean squared residual error + lambda*sum(nonintercept coefficients^2)
raw_prediction: support median SOH plus source ridge response;known-domain intercept available in both settings

source_only_lambda_selection.folds: 5 battery folds;SHA256 UTF8 battery_id integer modulo5;persist fold assignments before fitting
source_only_lambda_selection.criterion: domain-equal battery-macro MAE on held source battery post-support records
source_only_lambda_selection.tie_break: choose larger lambda among tied scores within1e-12
source_only_lambda_selection.scope: head-level source validation;encoder already trained on source85 prefix,so not full-pipeline out-of-fold validation

source_client_implementation: accumulate weighted XTX/XTy per original source client;sum sufficient statistics;do not export raw source rows as a claimed FL requirement

prediction_variants.primary: support-anchor cumulative minimum then clip[0,1.1],same for M1/M2
prediction_variants.sensitivity: clip-only;export both for every setting without target-based selection
prediction_variants.rationale: identical postprocessing between simple readouts;paper has its own frozen branch-level operators,so not a complete-method one-factor ablation

evaluation: individual component metrics as supplement,not ensemble uncertainty
interpretation_limits: M1vsM2 isolates domain-specific slopes within this fixed simple mapping family.
It does not quantify the domain-boundary contribution inside the complete paper predictor.
It does not establish independent ACfC/attention/balance contributions.
A source-trained ridge reference is a deliberately simple check,not proof all strong same-information competitors are worse.
The75 batteries retain their development evaluation status;these comparisons do not create a new blind holdout.
execution_order: freeze source battery fold IDs and numeric design schema
apply support20 adaptation and emit all query predictions
equal3 aggregation and paired battery report
update paper claims according to actual results
optional_after_this_only_if_claims_retai: Refit a common downstream prediction family on saved GRU/LSTM/KAN encoders to make an encoder-specific attribution.
Refit all dependent downstream components for balance/attention source-training interventions.
Define complete5/10shot feature/quality/head rules before retaining full-method label-budget curves.
